description: Client-side authentication helper functions using localStorage, including login, logout, profile management, and subscription to auth state changes.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Checks if the user is authenticated based on localStorage flag.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Sets the authentication flag in localStorage and notifies other tabs.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears authentication and profile data from localStorage and notifies other tabs.

methods.name: subscribeAuth
methods.description: Subscribes to authentication state changes across tabs via storage events.

methods.name: saveUserProfile
methods.description: Saves user profile data to localStorage with support for legacy fields.

methods.name: getUserProfile
methods.description: Retrieves and normalizes user profile data from localStorage.
